head: Two-layer GELU MLP, 64 hidden units, dropout 0.3
training: Three domain/class-balanced public training partitions, 120 AdamW epochs on CUDA; six hidden-size/seed candidates selected by minimum calibration AUC
decision: Rejected: better rankings do not yield a viable safe operating threshold; cautious calibration leaves public false allowances and blocks most legitimate actions. Nothing is loaded by Heliox.
limitations: A small public calibration set selected among six candidates; earlier results on the same official test sets motivated this adaptive experiment. The Heliox transfer is synthetic and previously inspected. This is neither a blind benchmark nor action authorization, live desktop evidence, or Jev parity.
